meta.title: Messages | Invessiv
meta.description: Your direct line to us: ask questions, give feedback and find everything about your project in one place.

page.heading: Messages
page.intro: Write to us right here. Everyone on your team with portal access sees the same conversation.

thread.emptyBody: Ask a question, give feedback or send us a link. On business days we usually reply within one day.
thread.inputHint: Enter sends, Shift + Enter adds a new line.

systemMessages.projectPhaseChanged: Your project “{projectTitle}” is now in the {phase} phase.
systemMessages.feedbackRoundHandedOver: Feedback round {roundNumber} for “{projectTitle}” is ready. It’s your turn.
systemMessages.feedbackRoundSubmitted: Feedback round {roundNumber} for “{projectTitle}” is submitted. We’re reviewing your feedback.
systemMessages.feedbackRoundDiscussionRequested: We’d like to talk through feedback round {roundNumber} for “{projectTitle}” with you.
systemMessages.feedbackRoundReturned: Feedback round {roundNumber} for “{projectTitle}” is open again. You can add to it.
systemMessages.feedbackRoundCompleted: Feedback round {roundNumber} for “{projectTitle}” is done. You’ll find the results on the feedback page.
systemMessages.feedbackApproved: “{projectTitle}” is approved in feedback round {roundNumber}. Thanks for your feedback.
systemMessages.onboardingSubmitted: Your onboarding for “{projectTitle}” is submitted. We’ll review your answers and get back to you.
systemMessages.onboardingReleased: Your onboarding for “{projectTitle}” is ready. It’s your turn.
systemMessages.onboardingChangesRequested: For your onboarding for “{projectTitle}” we still need something on: {blockTitles}. You can add it now.
